items.mainDefect: In join(), the loop breaks when the deadline expires, so the remaining flusher processes are never terminated.

secondary.defect: In join(), the check `isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process)` is always False for SpawnProcess, so terminate() never runs for any process.

items.mainDefect: submit() calls get_memory_info() and record_stored_segments() once per process buffer, which adds N cluster-wide Redis round-trips to the main thread.

secondary.defect: Each process buffer queries memory for the whole cluster, so the memory figures are counted N times.

items.mainDefect: The check `isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process)` is always False for SpawnProcess, so a hung process is never killed on restart and duplicate flushers run for the same shards.

secondary.defect: The same isinstance check also stops terminate() from being called in join().
